constraints.source: Weekdays I'm up at 7 and asleep by 11
constraints.paraphrase: On weekday nights (Sun-Thu) you go to bed by 23:00 and wake at 07:00.

constraints.source: I like math in the morning
constraints.paraphrase: You prefer to do MATH 2940 work in the morning (before 12:00).
You prefer to do ENGL 1170 work in the afternoon (12:00-17:00).

questions: What hours count as Friday night for you (for example 18:00 to midnight), and should work be completely off limits then or just avoided if possible?
